gates.detail: All schema versions and independent evaluation flag are valid
Every cue, representative frame, and overlapping shot is preserved
Carrier sweep covers the source and traces every discovered carrier
Every protocol field and action traces to the probe
Every capture action produced resolvable evidence
Inference provenance and reasoning are explicit
All unit ranges and frame references fit the source timeline
Channels, meaning changes, relationships, critical questions, and core evidence are accounted for
Internal meta-gate found no unchecked closure

examples.basis: Fresh recount against CQ-01 through CQ-15 in audit.json; candidate self-reported CQ statuses were not used as the score.

examples.note: The candidate recovers the ordered parallel map and all six names, rejects product-specific causality, preserves Steve Jobs-like appearance separately from literal identity/authorization, rejects the universal ‘任何人’ inference, counts two Runway looks and three 12-thumbnail Manus grids, preserves the 即梦 image-tool/animation gap, and states that no cross-tool handoff is shown.

The candidate clearly says the video is not a tutorial and lacks an operational chain, but it does not fully enumerate the audit's negative-space answer: no comparison criteria, ranking/selection guidance, price/version/link information, or CTA.

examples.basis: AE-001 through AE-025 in audit.json are the independent core content units. AE-026 is excluded because evidence-v2 no longer contains the old missing-frame defect and it is an evidence-pack quality item rather than video knowledge.

examples.note: All six cards and sublines, all six claims/results, Vidu likeness/Apple symbol, Runway's two complete looks, Manus 3×12, 即梦 scope gap, deictic-card dependence, global continuity, and absence of tool UI/workflow are reconstructed with valid references.
The candidate states the 16.556-second duration but does not reconstruct the audit's 1080×1920 dimensions and 30 fps as knowledge.

The candidate records no UI, prompts, parameters, filenames, generation state, export or handoff, but does not fully preserve the audited absence of price comparison, version, registration method, elapsed time, failure examples and CTA.

All six high-impact card sublines have OCR line IDs plus explicit frame-check decisions. OCR errors such as 视领/视频 and Al/AI are corrected only after visual checking; rejected PPT body-text proposals are not promoted to fact.

examples.basis: The denominator is the 31 top-level knowledge-unit statements whose provenance is visual_observation, author_claim, or system_inference; six top-level unknown units are excluded.

examples.note: It says Steve Jobs-like rather than literal Steve Jobs and separately preserves identity and authorization as unknown.
The conservative grouping rule yields two complete coordinated looks and does not overcount accessory/wipe states.
Three independently bounded shots each contain 12 visible thumbnails; 36 is explicitly limited to visible thumbnail instances, not deliverable files.

The exact 16.255-second energy boundary and final ~0.30-second silence are extra technical observations beyond the audit, but they are backed by the supplied derived audio/spectrogram and are not used to infer music or semantic function.

examples.basis: One primary cue/shot/targeted-frame/OCR/source localization was independently checked for each of the 37 knowledge units.

examples.note: Runway is correctly recovered at 9.1 seconds inside the short 9.067-9.3 card boundary.
The three Manus groups are correctly localized to SHOT-006, SHOT-007 and SHOT-008 rather than merged.
The card/cue/result relation is bounded across 13.72-16.5 seconds and supported by separate OCR, cue and moving-result evidence.

examples.basis: Fresh recount against U-01 through U-09 in audit.json.

examples.note: Inputs/prompts/parameters, output provenance, commercial/version conditions, Runway one-click operation, Vidu literal identity/authorization, the full Manus input-accuracy-citation-editability-export set, 即梦's intermediate animation program, non-speech audio semantics, and external truth of promotional cards all remain bounded unknowns.
‘任何人’ is not mislabeled as unknowable: the candidate correctly concludes that universal scope is not established by the single example, while leaving the actual supported range unknown.
